beats.en: The extract describes the inauguration on 10 May, which was a bright autumn day in South Africa. The ceremony took place at the sandstone amphitheatre formed by the Union Buildings in Pretoria.
beats.speakEn: The extract describes the inauguration on 10 May, which was a bright autumn day in South Africa. The ceremony took place at the sandstone amphitheatre formed by the Union Buildings in Pretoria.

beats.en: For decades the Union Buildings had been the seat of white supremacy, and now it was a rainbow gathering of colours and nations for South Africa's first democratic, non-racial government.
